text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I ran into 
Gran Alegria holding her head.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um... About three miles? Maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My head was spinning around and around, 
and my vision was swaying back and 
forth... like that...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, wah-wah-wah~!? It turned into 4 
miles~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Gran Alegria was troubled by a 
headache..."
